entry.name: mc.makelist
entry.digest: Create a list from non-signal output of MC objects
entry.description: The mc.makelist object creates a list of values whose size is determined by the highest voice number it receives in its right inlet or specified by the value of its voices attribute.

attributes.digest: Fixed Output Size
attributes.description: When theattribute is enabled and theattribute is non-zero, all list output will be the size set by the value of theattribute. attributes.digest: Set triggering behavior
attributes.description: Theattribute determines howoutputs its list in response to incoming values.

choices.label: Lists are output only when any message is received at the left inlet. Themode is useful when you want to decouple list output from incoming values.
Any value arriving at the middle inlet will trigger an output (default value of theattribute).

Themode (named for theobject) outputs a list when at least one value for each list position has been received since the last output. In order to work properly inmode,needs an initial value for itsattribute so it knows how many voices to keep track of.

Themode outputs a list immediately after a voice number received in the right inlet repeats for the first time after the last list output. This mode is useful when the list size might change over time.
Themode outputs a list immediately after a value for the highest voice number (as determined by the value ofattribute) is received.

messages.digest: Left inlet triggers output, middle inlet sets value of list at current voice number position using the first element in the input list, right inlet sets voice number for next value received in the middle inlet using the first element in the input list.
